{{AnimePokémonInfobox| ball=Unknown| type1=Fighting| type2=Steel| trainername=Cameron| pokemonname=Lucario| jtrainername=コテツ| jpokemonname=ルカリオ| tmtrainername=Kotetsu| tmpokemonname=Lucario| image=[[File:Cameron Lucario.png|250px]] | caption=Cameron's Lucario | location=[[Unova]] | gender=Unknown{{tt|*|Confirmed male in the games only}} | ability={{a|Inner Focus}}{{tt|*|Confirmed only in the games}} | epnum=BW093 | epname=Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!| evolution=1| firstevoep=BW107| firstevoname=Cameron's Secret Weapon! | prevonum=447| evo1num=448| firststagename=Riolu| secondstagename=Lucario| numeps1=14| current=[[Party|With Cameron]] | java1=[[Rikako Aikawa]]| enva2=[[Bill Rogers]] | java2=[[Rikako Aikawa]]| }} '''Cameron's Lucario''' (Japanese: '''コテツのルカリオ''' ''Kotetsu's Lucario'') is the first Pokémon that {{un|Cameron}} is shown to have. It is also his main Pokémon and tends to walk around [[Walking Pokémon|outside of its Poké Ball]]. ==In animation== ===History=== [[File:Cameron and Lucario.png|thumb|left|250px|Lucario and Cameron]] Lucario first appeared in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'' as a {{p|Riolu}}. They revealed that they had come to enter the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] only to find out that it had already ended, much to Cameron's displeasure. Later, Cameron and Riolu revealed to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} that they planned on entering the [[Unova League]], but only had seven [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s. In ''[[BW094|The Road to Humilau!]]'', Cameron and Riolu joined Ash and his friends to travel to the [[Humilau Gym]] so Cameron could get his final Gym Badge. After getting lost and separated from {{an|Cilan}} and {{an|Iris}}, Riolu, Cameron, Ash, {{AP|Pikachu}}, and {{an|Meloetta}} fled into a cave to shield themselves from the pouring rain and stayed there for the night. Later, they met [[Marlon]], the Humilau Gym Leader, who took them to the Humilau Gym so that Cameron could have his Gym battle. Although Cameron wanted to use Riolu in the fight, he accidentally left it on the side, forcing him to use his other Pokémon to defeat Marlon. Afterwards, Riolu and Cameron went their separate ways from Ash and his friends. Later, Riolu reappeared with its {{pkmn|Trainer}} at [[Vertress City]], where they camped out near the building where the [[Vertress Conference]] was being held. After Cameron revealed he forgot to enter in the tournament, Ash dragged the two to the building to register. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', Riolu was used against [[Bianca's Emboar]] in the Vertress Conference. Despite the much larger size of its opponent, Riolu was able to gain an advantage by using {{m|Circle Throw}} to use Emboar's weight against him. Emboar quickly regained the advantage in the fight, but Riolu countered by copying his {{m|Flamethrower}} with {{m|Copycat}}. Eventually, Riolu defeated Emboar with {{m|Vacuum Wave}}, making Cameron the victor of the battle. In ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', Riolu defeated [[Kenton]]'s {{p|Gigalith}}, which allowed Cameron to progress to the Top 8 of the Vertress Conference. [[File:BW108.png|thumb|250px|Lucario battling Pikachu]] In ''[[BW107|Cameron's Secret Weapon!]]'', Riolu was used against [[Ash's Unfezant]] in the Vertress Conference. Despite being at a disadvantage, Riolu easily defeated the Proud Pokémon. Next, it faced [[Ash's Snivy]] and managed to quickly overpower her. However, Snivy made a comeback and countered all of Riolu's attacks, eventually sending it back with a powerful {{m|Leaf Storm}}. This caused Riolu to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a {{p|Lucario}}, making it much stronger. [[BW108|The battle continued]], and Lucario was able to use its new strength to easily overpower Snivy before knocking her out with its newly learned {{m|Aura Sphere}}. Lucario then battled with Ash's Pikachu. The damage Pikachu took from battling {{p|Samurott}} and {{p|Swanna}} quickly put him at a disadvantage, allowing Lucario to defeat Pikachu with Aura Sphere and win the battle for Cameron. In the semifinals, Cameron found himself up against [[Virgil]] and his team of [[Eeveelution]]s. The final battle came down to between Lucario and Virgil's {{p|Flareon}}; however, Lucario had already been weakened by Virgil's {{p|Espeon}} and was quickly finished off by Flareon's [[Type#Type effectiveness|super effective]] {{m|Fire Blast}}, eliminating Cameron from the competition. ===Personality and characteristics=== Lucario's personality is a blend of loyalty and occasional exasperation. It often gets annoyed by its Trainer's forgetfulness, yet it remains friendly and sociable with both its Trainer and other Pokémon. This amiable nature likely stems from its [[Evolution]] from Riolu, which requires a strong bond of friendship. In battle, Lucario is an exceptionally strong and capable fighter. Even as a Riolu, it demonstrated impressive power by defeating larger opponents like [[Bianca's Emboar]] and [[Kenton]]'s {{p|Gigalith}}. This prowess continued after its Evolution, allowing it to hold its own against fully evolved Pokémon. It also showed it has great stamina immediately after it evolved, enough to handle the tough challenges of both Ash's Pikachu and Snivy. Interestingly, Lucario, even after evolving, tends to mimic its Trainer's actions. This trait was evident during its debut and in ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', when it copied Cameron's distress after Russet's family accidentally destroyed their tent.
